description: This file defines the JmsListenerFactory class, which manages the lifecycle of JMS message listeners within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles loading, initializing, refreshing, and closing JMS listeners, supporting dynamic configuration based on Service and Server models. The class also runs a dedicated thread to manage listener connection states.

classes.name: JmsListenerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for managing JMS listeners, including dynamic loading, thread management, and lifecycle control within the OFBiz service framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton access method to obtain the JmsListenerFactory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: JmsListenerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory and starts its management thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main thread loop for periodically loading and checking JMS listeners until all are connected or the thread is interrupted.

methods.name: loadListeners
methods.description: Loads JMS listeners based on current configuration, creating and initializing listener instances as needed.

methods.name: loadListener
methods.description: Creates and initializes a specific listener based on server configuration, dynamically loading listener classes.

methods.name: loadListener
methods.description: Overloaded method to load a listener with just the serverKey, fetching configuration from stored servers.

methods.name: closeListener
methods.description: Closes a specific JMS listener identified by serverKey.

methods.name: refreshListener
methods.description: Refreshes a specified JMS listener, typically reinitializing its connection.

methods.name: getJMSListeners
methods.description: Returns a modifiable map of current JMS listeners.
